scripts.coverage:merge: mkdir -p .nyc_output && echo 'Starting coverage file search...' && find apps packages -type f -path '*/coverage/*' -name 'coverage-final.json' > coverage-files.txt && echo 'Search completed. Found:' && cat coverage-files.txt && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=fs.readFileSync('coverage-files.txt','utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);console.log('Found coverage files:', files.length);const merged={};files.forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)){try{const content=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));console.log('Processing file:', f, 'with', Object.keys(content).length, 'entries');Object.assign(merged,content);console.log('Merged coverage from:', f);}catch(e){console.error('Error processing file:', f, e);}}});fs.writeFileSync('.nyc_output/coverage.json',JSON.stringify(merged));console.log('Merged coverage written to .nyc_output/coverage.json, with', Object.keys(merged).length, 'total entries');" && rm coverage-files.txt
